meta.note: A map of the game in modules, made from fields.json. No game file reads this file. Nothing here changes what the game does.
meta.status_note: working: built and has a test file. partial: built, with a named gap in REQUESTS.md or AUDIT.md. unfinished: built, with its switch off or its database file not applied yet. dead: in the code, never shown. unsure: not checked by hand and fields found by scan only. broken: a known failure (none today: game/tests/known-failures.json is empty).
